# BalkanEstateAI

> The only AI-powered real estate platform covering all 10 Balkan countries. Search property for sale and rent in Montenegro, Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Romania, and Greece. Available in 10 languages with AI-powered natural language search.

## About

BalkanEstateAI is the leading pan-Balkan property marketplace. Unlike regional competitors (Realitica covers 4 countries, Indomio uses separate sites per country), BalkanEstateAI is the only single platform covering all 10 Balkan nations with AI-powered search, AI property valuations, and support for 10 native languages.

- Website: https://balkanestateai.com
- Founded: 2024
- Languages: English, Albanian, Serbian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Bosnian, Macedonian, Montenegrin, Romanian, Greek
- Countries: Serbia, Montenegro, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Albania, Kosovo, Bulgaria, Romania, Greece

## Key Pages

- [Property Search](https://balkanestateai.com/search): Search all property listings across 10 Balkan countries with AI-powered natural language search
- [Rental Properties](https://balkanestateai.com/rentals): Apartments and houses for rent across the Balkans
- [Real Estate Agents](https://balkanestateai.com/agents): Find verified real estate agents across the Balkans
- [Real Estate Agencies](https://balkanestateai.com/agencies): Browse agencies by country and city
- [Explore Cities](https://balkanestateai.com/explore-cities): City guides with property market data and recommendations
- [AI Property Valuation](https://balkanestateai.com/valuation): Free AI-powered property price estimates for any Balkan property
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://balkanestateai.com/mortgage-calculator): Calculate mortgage payments for Balkan properties
- [Buying Guides](https://balkanestateai.com/guides): Country-specific property buying guides for foreigners
- [How It Works](https://balkanestateai.com/how-it-works): Platform overview for buyers, sellers, agents, and agencies

- [Montenegro](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Montenegro): Budva, Kotor, Tivat, Podgorica, Herceg Novi

- [Kosovo](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Kosovo): Pristina, Prizren
- [North Macedonia](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=North+Macedonia): Skopje, Ohrid, Bitola
- [Serbia](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Serbia): Belgrade, Novi Sad, Nis
- [Croatia](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Croatia): Split, Dubrovnik, Zagreb
- [Bosnia and Herzegovina](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Bosnia): Sarajevo, Mostar
- [Bulgaria](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Bulgaria): Sofia, Burgas, Varna
- [Romania](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Romania): Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Brasov
- [Greece](https://balkanestateai.com/search?country=Greece): Athens, Thessaloniki, Crete
